title: Investigation by the Department of Public Utilities on its own motion as to the propriety of an amendment, negotiated with the New Brunswick Electric Power Commission, to a contract for the purchase of 100 MW of power from the Point Lepreau nuclear unit located in the Province of New Brunswick in Canada, entered into by the parties on August 31, 1981 and approved by the Department in D.P.U. 911 on November 23, 1981.
